# Plausible Analytics

Privacy-focused web analytics platform that provides simple, lightweight, and GDPR-compliant website statistics

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/plausible-analytics/.

## Actions

- **Get Aggregate Stats** (read-only): Retrieve aggregated metrics for a given time period from Plausible Analytics.
- **Get Breakdown Stats** (read-only): Retrieve breakdown statistics for a specific property (dimension) from Plausible Analytics.
- **Get Plugin Capabilities** (read-only): Retrieve available capabilities for the Plausible Analytics Plugins API.
- **Get Realtime Visitors** (read-only): Retrieve the number of current visitors on your site in the last 5 minutes.
- **Get Timeseries Stats** (read-only): Retrieve timeseries visitor data from Plausible Analytics over a specified time period.
- **List Custom Properties** (read-only): List all custom properties configured for a site.
- **List Goals** (read-only): List all goals configured for a site.
- **List Site Guests** (read-only): List all guest users who have access to a site's dashboard in Plausible Analytics.
- **List Sites** (read-only): List all sites the API key owner's Plausible account can access.
- **List Teams** (read-only): List all teams available for the API key owner.
- **Query Analytics Stats** (read-only): Query analytics stats for a site using the Stats API v2.
- **Record Event**: Record a pageview or custom event via the Plausible Events API.
- **Check API Health** (read-only): Check the health status of the Plausible Analytics API.
- **Get Site Details** (read-only): Retrieve details for a specific Plausible Analytics site.
